scientific_integrity: Proof is symbolic for arbitrary finite orders; finite exhaustive tests n=1,...,6 are diagnostic. This is not independently validated or certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-domain, fixed-vertex-label, all-valuation pointwise semantics for loop-free symmetric frames. No ordinary box modality, no graph isomorphism quotient, and no claim for arbitrary relations. The univariate counting formula is the previously established OEIS A093352 identity; previous general non-contingency bisimulation theory is acknowledged. Full-text priority comparison with a 2014 paper and a 2026 thesis remains incomplete.
title: The isolated-edge kernel of finite symmetric non-contingency frames
